subQuestions.questionText: Which ONE of the following can be considered a strong password?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: C Spr!ng+w@t3r (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: You need to backup an entire hard drive. Which of the following devices is best suited for this purpose?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: A Portable hard drive (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A ... component is unlikely to be found in a new computer.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: D DVD-writer (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A ... is NOT an example of a peripheral.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B motherboard (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The URL of a website refers to ...
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: A a way for users to identify a website on the internet (1 mark)

options.A: a way for users to identify a website on the internet.
options.B: the relative ranking of the website by a search engine.
options.C: the password needed to access the website.
options.D: the e-mail address of the webmaster of the website.

subQuestions.questionText: If you think the web page you are viewing is outdated (old), you can ...
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: D refresh the page (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Which upgrade will most likely improve the performance of a PC?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: A Adding more memory (RAM) (1 mark)

options.B: Increasing the refresh rate of the monitor

subQuestions.questionText: ... refers to the use of resource material without acknowledgement.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B Plagiarism (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Which ONE of the following should NOT be used as a data source?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B A database report (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: For which ONE of the following fields in a database will you most likely use an input mask?
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: A The cellphone number of a client (1 mark)

options.A: The cellphone number of a client
options.C: The number of items ordered by the client
options.D: The web address of a client's company

subQuestions.questionText: High-speed internet connection, which is referred to as 'always on'. Choose a term/concept from: A switch, B web page, C broadband, D fraud, E AI, F firewall, G VPN, H software, I bandwidth, J patch, K cell spacing, L blockchain, M AR, N copyright, O digital footprint, P website, Q Bluetooth, R service pack, S cell padding, T hub.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: C broadband (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A collection of instructions that enables a computer to perform specific tasks. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: H software (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Used to connect multiple devices within a LAN. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: A switch OR T hub (either accepted) (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A preventative action to protect your work from piracy. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: N copyright (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Used to encrypt and secure your internet traffic. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: G VPN (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Machines that can perform tasks (autonomously) that would normally require human action. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: E AI (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Setting the space between the content of a cell and its border in an HTML table. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: S cell padding (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Used to fix a specific programming problem in software. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: J patch (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The electronic record of a person's online activity. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: O digital footprint (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A single HTML file on the internet. Choose the matching term from the same COLUMN B list as 2.1.
subQuestions.memoText: Correct answer: B web page (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): A hub allows a computer to send and receive data via a telephone line.
subQuestions.memoText: False – Modem/Router/ADSL (1 mark). Candidates must supply the correct term (Modem, Router or ADSL) to earn the mark — the word FALSE alone is not enough.

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): ISP is a company that provides a service, such as web page hosting.
subQuestions.memoText: True (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): The data label is a visual indicator on a graph of related sets of values in an Excel worksheet/spreadsheet.
subQuestions.memoText: False – Legend (1 mark). Candidates must supply the correct term (Legend) to earn the mark — the word FALSE alone is not enough.

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): Green computing is the study of the impact of technology on users.
subQuestions.memoText: False – Ergonomics (1 mark). Candidates must supply the correct term (Ergonomics) to earn the mark — the word FALSE alone is not enough. (Green computing refers to the environmental impact of technology; Ergonomics is the study of the impact of technology/equipment design on users.)

subQuestions.questionText: Indicate whether the following statement is TRUE or FALSE. Correct it if FALSE by changing the underlined word(s): In word processing, auto numbering can also start when you type a number with a full stop, then a space, followed by text.
subQuestions.memoText: True (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Give ONE example of a device that can be classified as an input device and output device.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: (Multi-)touchscreen/Smartphone/Smartwatch/Tablet; force feedback steering wheel/joystick/headset; multi-function scanner/printer; interactive whiteboard. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Describe TWO ways in which communication in an information cycle takes place.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Send and receive information between different devices (transfer of files, downloading files, multimedia files); sharing information between different networks; information can be accessed and updated; sharing of information via channels such as e-mail, instant messaging, video conferencing, etc.; transmission of feedback/error messages that requires a response from the user, etc.; transmission of voice messages from a user to a device/system; allows ICT devices to connect with each other. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Data and information are crucial elements in an ICT system. Describe what is meant by data and give an example.
subQuestions.memoText: Data refers to raw facts (1 mark) which as such does not have any meaning/is unprocessed facts/not analysed (1 mark). Example: a list of numbers or words (1 mark). (Note to marker: accept any other valid example.) (3 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Data and information are crucial elements in an ICT system. Describe TWO processes that will transform data into information.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Analyse the data; interpret the data; organise (raw) data. (Note to marker: accept a description of any TWO of the above processes.) (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Describe TWO ways how you could determine if your computer has been infected by malware.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Drastic decrease in performance/computer slows down; pop-ups (ransomware message, etc.) or error messages or anti-virus notifications; changes to your browser settings; high amounts of network traffic/unexplained high data usage; decrease in storage space; information/files/folders on the computer go missing; changes to your Windows settings/programs not working; computer sending messages autonomously, etc. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO ways in which spooling can be utilised in a network printer.
subQuestions.memoText: Documents sent to the printer can be, any TWO: Paused; cancelled/restarted; given preference/prioritised; placed in a queue. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO disadvantages of frequently defragmenting a hard drive.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Can increase the wear and tear of the hard drive, which can cause it to fail more quickly/decrease the life span of the hard drive; can be a time-consuming process; it slows down the overall performance of the computer while it is running; could result in corrupted files. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Briefly explain the purpose of a user interface (UI) and give an example of an input device commonly used with a user interface.
subQuestions.memoText: Purpose: It is a way to interact with your operating system or programs (1 mark). Example (Any one): Mouse, touch screen, stylus or keyboard, any other input device (1 mark). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The new monitor you connected to your computing device displays a resolution error message. Where would you change the resolution to resolve/fix this error message?
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: Search bar: type Resolution: System setting: Display; right click on desktop: Display settings; right click on Start: Settings/System: Display; Windows Key + i. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO disadvantages of convergence.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Functionality of many devices is lost if the device fails; shorter battery life for mobile convergence devices; high hardware demand; reduced specialisation; security and privacy risks; mastering of additional skills/overload; device is more expensive (because of greater functionality); difficult to upgrade one component of the device. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO reasons why a company would choose to use grid computing.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: No need to buy powerful computing devices to perform complex processing; complex calculations can be performed/increased computing power; uninterrupted processing; tasks are performed in parallel thereby improving performance; uses idle resources. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO limitations of firewalls.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Unable to protect against the transfer of files or software/social engineering; it does not prevent misuse of passwords from dialling in to or out of the internal network; firewalls are not able to stop users from accessing data or information from malicious websites; already infected systems cannot be secured by firewalls; changing settings on the firewall can hamper network traffic. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO possible solutions to resolve restrictions (bottlenecks) in data flow that appear in local storage areas.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Make use of an SSD/faster hard disk drive; use drives/peripherals with high cache capacities; optimise/defragment the storage; compress data; increase capacity. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO reasons why you would choose a wireless network for a home or a small business.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Easy to install; less cable clutter/no wires; easy to connect to; added mobility/flexibility; easy to expand. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO good guidelines/hints for users using video conferencing.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO (from any category): Formal etiquette protocols, e.g. dress appropriately, use formal language, no multi-tasking, fair participation, correct posture, etc.; Equipment, e.g. good speakers, good microphone, good web camera, good internet connection, UPS (continuous power supply); Environment, e.g. quiet environment, suitable lighting, appropriate location; Software, e.g. close unused applications, record and transcribe. (Note to marker: any TWO appropriate guidelines.) (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: What is the function of an NIC?
subQuestions.memoText: The NIC is used to connect a device to a network (cable). (Note to marker: only accept connection, not communication.) (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Name any TWO technologies that form part of the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR).
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Artificial Intelligence (AI); Augmented reality (AR); Virtual reality (VR); 3D/4D printing; Cloud computing; IoT; Robotics; Quantum computing; Block chain; Automation, self-driving cars, machine learning; Genetic engineering; Drone technology. (Note to marker: accept any correct technology.) (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO advantages of cloud computing in terms of storage.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Save storage space on local device; storage can be accessed from anywhere; storage can be accessed on any device; faster access because of more powerful processors; it offers back-up and recovery functions; latest updates, scalability and security are catered for. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO factors to consider when installing wireless access points in a network.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Security it offers, e.g. strong passwords; distance/area it covers; different WiFi standards, which differ in speed, transmission ranges and frequency; number of clients connecting; signal interference. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO disadvantages of using a PAN.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Limited range – only a few metres; data transmission may be slow; prone to interference; limited number of devices can be connected/paired. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Study the picture below, which shows two connection scenarios in a box labelled with a laptop icon, a router/server icon, and a globe icon representing the internet. In the top row, labelled 'Normal everyday connection', the laptop connects to the router/server icon at 100 Mbps, and the router/server icon connects to the globe icon labelled 'Internet' at 100 Mbps. In the bottom row, labelled 'Current internet connection', the same laptop connects to a box labelled 'ISP' at only 0.4 Mbps (shown with a thinner/dashed arrow), while the ISP still connects to the Internet globe icon at the full 100 Mbps. Analyse the picture and give the term and description for the process illustrated.
subQuestions.memoText: Term: Throttling/policing (1 mark). Description: Occurs when the ISP slows down the internet speed due to excessive data downloads/not adhering to the FUP (Fair Use Policy) (1 mark). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: What is the importance of report writing in the PAT?
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: The reader must have a clear understanding of the content; displays a clear link between the original task/problem, research, discussion and conclusion; share findings with the target audience; gives a summary of your findings. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Give TWO considerations when formulating a task definition.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Understand the current situation/describe the problem area; identify the information needed to solve the information problem; determine the focus area/question; determine the steps to complete the task; determine the target audience. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A learner wants to show how the number of e-book readers have increased/decreased over a period of time using a chart. What spreadsheet feature can be used to show this on the chart?
subQuestions.memoText: Trend line/Drop lines. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO aspects to consider when planning a questionnaire.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Identify research aims and the goal of the questionnaire; target audience; type of questionnaire – electronic, written, etc.; consider the type of questions (open/closed)/information needed; design question sequence and overall layout. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Evaluation of the contents of a website is essential in research. Briefly explain why evaluation is essential.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: There are no guidelines for publishing on the web; most information that is published on the web is not filtered and evaluated like books, journals, magazines, or newspapers; to ensure/assess the quality/credibility/suitability of the website; currency – is the information up to date? (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Evaluation of the contents of a website is essential in research. State TWO criteria used for evaluating websites.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Affiliation (e.g. who supports the website?); audience (e.g. level at which it is written/who is it intended for?); authority (e.g. who is the author, and what are their credentials?); coverage (e.g. organisation of content and working links); currency (e.g. is the information up to date?); objectivity (e.g. does it reflect any bias?); accuracy (e.g. does it correlate with other sources?). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Briefly describe the positive impact of ICT on the global community.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Ease of global travel; improved global communication; important information or news can be shared; new learning opportunities and different ways of learning; new ways to do business/health care/etc.; reduced impact on ecosystem – less driving, flying, printing, etc.; telecommuting; virtual communities; more economically viable. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Name TWO common internet attacks, other than malware.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks; phishing; spoofing; cyberterrorism; sniffer attacks; code (SQL) injection attacks; supply chain attacks; insider threats; zero-day exploit. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Briefly describe what data protection is AND give ONE method to protect data/information, excluding any physical methods.
subQuestions.memoText: Description: Data protection is about safeguarding your data/information from unauthorised access (1 mark). Method (Any one): Passwords; firewalls; VPN; encryption; backup; two-factor authentication (1 mark). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: What are the responsibilities of a network administrator to ensure network security?
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Keep records of software; keep records of hardware; ensure that only approved software is installed/updated; ensure privacy; manage usernames and passwords; put security measures in place, e.g. access rights/blocking access of external storage devices; develop an acceptable user policy (AUP); backup and recovery. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: State TWO ways how a company can prevent data loss when unscheduled power failures occur.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Use Autosave; install a UPS; install an inverter; make use of solar panels, a battery bank, etc. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Discuss TWO reasons why you would use page headers and page footers in a document AND give an example of the type of information that can be included in a header or a footer.
subQuestions.memoText: Reasons (Any TWO): To repeat information at the top/bottom of every page; provides a description of the document contents; provide information about different sections of a multi-page document; easy navigation (2 marks). Example (Any one): Document information, properties, fields, dates, page number, file name, etc. (Note to marker: accept any correct example.) (1 mark). (3 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Your friend generated a spreadsheet for stationery items sold to a customer. However, the total for all the stationery items displays zero as an answer. Study the screenshot below: column B is headed 'Items' and lists, from row 7 to row 13, Staplers, Erasers, Pens, Drawing pins, Paper clips, Rubber stamps and Highlighters. Column C is headed 'Prices' and lists, in the same rows, R704,00, R217,00, R250,00, R156,00, R66,00, R490,00 and R178,00 next to the matching items. Row 14 is labelled 'TOTAL', and the cell next to it (in column C) contains the formula =SUM(B7:B13) and displays 0. Give TWO reasons why the function returns a zero.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Incorrect cell range: B7:B13 instead of C7:C13; incorrect function used; column B is text/cannot calculate text. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Microsoft Access provides field property settings such as validation rules to improve the accuracy of data capturing. Name TWO other additional field properties that can be used.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Input masks; field sizes; default values; lookup values, like List Box, Combo Box, Check Box; formatting, e.g. medium date. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Name a word processing feature which will force certain text to move to the beginning of the next column.
subQuestions.memoText: Column break. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Briefly explain the criteria of the following validation rule: <0 or >=5
subQuestions.memoText: The number entered is less than 0 (negative numbers) or numbers 5 and above / numbers from 0 to 4 are excluded. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The following criteria appears for the Username field in a database query: Like "??an*". Explain the output of this query.
subQuestions.memoText: Returns a Username with: ?? – compulsory 2 start characters (1 mark); followed by 'an' – the characters 'an' as the 3rd and 4th characters (1 mark); followed by '*' – a string of length 0 or more (1 mark). (3 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Examine the piece of HTML code below, which is used to insert an image on the web page: . What effect will the missing height attribute have on the image?
subQuestions.memoText: The image will resize proportionally (maintain aspect ratio). (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Give ONE reason why you would use the button in the image below in an Access database table. The image shows a small square button with a large sigma (summation) symbol (Σ) on it, labelled 'Totals'.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: Show/hide column totals; to display a summary of a field by using a total/aggregate function. (Note to marker: accept a specific example, e.g. SUM, AVG, COUNT, MAX, MIN, etc.) (1 mark)

questions.title: Integrated Scenario — Community Hall Gaming Room

subQuestions.questionText: The management of the community hall decided to open a gaming room. The gaming room will include access to board games and video games. The management needs to purchase PCs for the gaming room and are considering PCs with the following specifications: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core 3.4 GHz (up to 4.6 GHz) processor; MSI GeForce RTX 3070 graphics card; MSI x570 chipset AM4 ATX motherboard; 32 GB DDR4 3 600 MHz gaming memory; 1 TB Gen4 NVMe SSD; Corsair Airflow 5000D ATX gaming chassis; Microsoft Windows 11; NOD32 antivirus; Office 365; Microsoft mouse and keyboard; and including a steering wheel/joystick. What kind of computer user will most likely use a computer with these specifications?
subQuestions.memoText: Power/Super user/(gamer). (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The community hall is buying new PCs, which include a monitor. How is the size of monitors normally measured?
subQuestions.memoText: Monitors are measured diagonally. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The management of the community hall is buying gaming PCs with specifications that include an AMD Ryzen 7 5700X processor, an MSI GeForce RTX 3070 graphics card, 32 GB RAM, a 1 TB Gen4 NVMe SSD, Microsoft Windows 11, NOD32 antivirus and Office 365. Name TWO types of utility software that can be used on this computer.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Antivirus; disk clean-up; disk defragment; backup; file compressing; task scheduler; file management, etc. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The management of the community hall is buying gaming PCs for the gaming room. Suggest TWO additional hardware devices that can be bought for this computer.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Blu-ray ROM/DVD ROM; VR glasses; printer; scanner; screen/big screen; speakers; webcam; video capture card; microphone, etc. (Note to marker: accept gaming hardware not listed in the specifications given on the paper.) (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A small network needs to be created with ten computers in the gaming room. What type of cabled media will most likely be used to connect the computers? Motivate your answer.
subQuestions.memoText: Type of cable (Any one): UTP/STP (twisted pair); CAT 5/6; Ethernet/LAN cable (1 mark). Motivation (Any one): Most cost-effective solution; easier to set up than fibre optics (1 mark). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: A small network needs to be created with ten computers in the gaming room. Give ONE reason why this network would NOT require a server.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: Each computer is managed on its own; no server is required on a gaming network; no need for centralised access to files; games are often hosted on a local computer. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A printer will be added to the gaming room network for administration purposes. State TWO factors that should be considered when buying a printer.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Type of printer; colour; speed; resolution (dpi)/graphics capability/photo printing; paper type and size; system compatibility; wireless capability; cost per page; budget available; mobility; future needs; affordability; energy-saving features; print from storage device. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The new computers in the gaming room must be secured and protected. Name TWO physical safeguards to protect the computers.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Burglar bars; security guard; steel doors; mesh in the roof; locks; alarm system; cameras. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The new computers in the gaming room must be secured and protected. What technology can the management add to all devices/equipment to ensure easy tracking/monitoring of devices/equipment?
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: RFID; barcode/QR codes/stickers; Bluetooth tracking devices. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The secure storage area of the gaming room is protected by a lock which opens by scanning a fingerprint. Briefly explain what this type of security is called and give ONE disadvantage.
subQuestions.memoText: Biometric security (1 mark). Disadvantage of fingerprint biometric security (Any one): Dirty fingerprint will not scan; changes in fingerprint structure will not allow access; cannot be shared, person must be present; if the surface of the biometric device is dirty, it will not scan the finger correctly. (Note to marker: accept any valid answer.) (1 mark). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Virtual reality games are very popular among the community members using the gaming room. Briefly explain what virtual reality is.
subQuestions.memoText: The use of technology to create a simulation of a 3D environment (1 mark) that can be interacted with by a person in a seemingly real or physical way (1 mark). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Virtual reality games are very popular among the community members using the gaming room. Give TWO disadvantages or limitations of virtual reality.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Physical effects, e.g. motion sickness, injuries, etc.; psychological effects, e.g. moral and ethical concerns/inability to distinguish between what is real and what is virtual; limited availability of the special equipment, like VR glasses, video cameras. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The management of the community hall decided to host a gaming tournament. Special gaming chairs were bought for the tournament. Give ONE feature that a gaming chair should have.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ergonomic-related answer, any ONE: Adjustable armrest; adjustable height; movable base; breathable material; gaming-related enhancements, etc. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The management of the community hall decided to host a gaming tournament. Give TWO examples of how ICT can be used to advertise the tournament.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Social media (accept any two examples for two marks); website; e-mail; radio and television broadcast. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The management of the community hall decided to host a gaming tournament. What Microsoft Office application is best suited to capture and store the individual entries for the tournament?
subQuestions.memoText: Access. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The management wants to send a standard letter to all tournament participants to thank them. What word processing feature can be used to quickly generate a personalised, standard thank-you letter for each participant?
subQuestions.memoText: Mail merge. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Your school has decided to hold a team racing car competition. Teams must create their own racing cars from scratch using specific guidelines regarding car weight. Teams consist of learners in the same grade. A maximum of 10 drivers per team are allowed. Study the entry form for registration below: it has blank-line fields for '1. Team name', '2. Car weight', '3. Number of drivers', a yes/no question '4. Do you have a disabled team member? Yes/No', and item '5.', which is a small table headed 'Grade' with columns for grades 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12, each with an empty cell/tick-box below it. Suggest THREE ways in which the layout of this form can be improved for electronic use.
subQuestions.memoText: Any THREE: Use text form fields; make use of checkboxes; make use of dropdown fields/combo box/list box; use a template. (3 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: The racing car competition entry form has fields for '1. Team name', '2. Car weight', '3. Number of drivers', '4. Do you have a disabled team member? Yes/No', and '5.' a grade selection table (grades 8 to 12). Write down ONE question in the form that can be improved by changing it to a closed-ended question. Describe how you would improve it.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE (question and reason): Number of drivers – limit choice to 10 drivers (a fixed maximum, selected rather than typed); car weight – give weight categories, e.g. >100 kg or <100 kg, selected from a list; team name – choice of names given in a list. (Question, 1 mark, and reason, 1 mark.) (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Information from the electronic racing car competition entry forms is sent to a spreadsheet. Name ONE online application that can be used to capture the entry form data.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: Google Forms; Microsoft Forms. (Note to marker: accept any other online form application.) (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Information from the electronic racing car competition entry forms is sent to a spreadsheet. Give TWO advantages of using online forms.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: More accurate/validation/fewer errors in data input; easy to collect/short turnaround time; easy management and analysis of data; easy to share, etc.; quick to complete/fill in; eco-friendly, e.g. no use of paper/saves paper; wider audience can be reached; online forms are freely available. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Information from the electronic racing car competition entry forms is sent to a spreadsheet. Name a spreadsheet feature that will allow you to highlight all racing cars that meet a certain criterion.
subQuestions.memoText: Conditional formatting. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: How can a 3D printer be used to create a distinguishing feature for each racing car?
subQuestions.memoText: Number plate/badge/logo/emblem/hood ornament, etc. (Note to marker: accept any design/accessories feature.) (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: During the racing car event, the races will be streamed. Briefly explain what streaming is.
subQuestions.memoText: The event/video will be watched live (1 mark) without downloading (1 mark). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: During the racing car event, a camera fixed onto a drone will record the races. State TWO ways how data can be transferred from the drone camera to the computer for streaming.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: WiFi connection; Bluetooth connection; cellular connection; satellite; microwave; WiMax; SD card; use USB cable. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: During the racing car event, the broadcasting computer must have a high-speed connection. Give an example of a high-speed connection.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: LTE/4G/5G (cellular connection); Fibre; Satellite. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Internet speed is usually indicated in the following format: 30/5 Mbps. What do the numbers usually represent?
subQuestions.memoText: 30 – download speed (1 mark); 5 – upload speed (1 mark). (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: Internet speed is usually indicated in the following format: 30/5 Mbps. What unit of measurement is used for internet speed?
subQuestions.memoText: Bits per second. (Note to marker: also accept Megabits per second.) (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Certificates for the racing car competition are created in a word processor using a standardised document. What is this standardised document called?
subQuestions.memoText: Template. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The racing car competition will be covered by the school newspaper. The school newspaper will be publishing photos of the event. What word processing feature will they use to include a visible description above/below the photos?
subQuestions.memoText: Caption. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The racing car competition will be covered by the school newspaper. When pasting the table containing the results of the races, it does not fit across the width of the page of the word processing document. Suggest an appropriate action to resolve this problem.
subQuestions.memoText: Any ONE: Auto fit to contents; auto fit to window; change page orientation to landscape. (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: The racing car competition will be covered by the school newspaper. Suggest TWO ways how the school newspaper can give recognition to community members who contributed photos and articles about the races.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Citation; bibliography; photo with caption; footnote/endnote; acknowledgement. (2 marks)

subQuestions.questionText: According to the POPI Act, geographic information is regarded as private. Other than geographic metadata, give TWO examples of metadata that can be added to photos.
subQuestions.memoText: Any TWO: Type of camera used; time when photo was taken; author; date; ISO, etc. (2 marks)
